  "summary": "The requirement SFMC-REQ-024 is a clear, testable software requirement specifying that the SFMC software must provide functionality for the pilot to mark outgoing messages as emergency messages. It is well aligned with the communications subsystem described in the SRS (Section 2.6 Communications System) and the related communications requirements (Section 3.5 Communications). The requirement is precise and unambiguous, with no undefined terms or vague criteria. There is no explicit software allocation detail in the SRS, but the requirement clearly pertains to software functionality within the SFMC communications controls.
